message:
feat: add circuit breaker for ApiConnectionException (Stripe degradation)

Stripe outage 2024-11-08: ApiConnectionException timeouts caused 87% payment failures.
com.stripe.exception.ApiConnectionException — no circuit breaker existed.
Added Resilience4j circuit breaker (threshold: 50% errors/60s) with queue-based
fallback. Zero transactions lost. Stripe connectivity now fault-tolerant.
Reviewed-by: payments-team
